answer.sql:
WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM Claim_Coverage AS cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail AS pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy AS p
      ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount AS ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment AS lp
      ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve AS lr
      ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment AS ep
      ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve AS er
      ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
premium_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
    FROM Policy_Amount AS pa
    JOIN Premium AS pr
      ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        Agreement_Identifier,
        Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE UPPER(Party_Role_Code) IN ('POLICYHOLDER', 'POLICY_HOLDER', 'POLICY HOLDER')
),
agents AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        Agreement_Identifier,
        Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE UPPER(Party_Role_Code) IN ('AGENT', 'PRODUCER')
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    cp.Policy_Number,
    ph.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier,
    ag.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Party_Identifier,
    COALESCE(ca.Loss_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(ca.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(ca.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(ca.Expense_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(pa.Premium_Amount_Paid, 0) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
FROM Claim AS c
JOIN claim_policy AS cp
  ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts AS ca
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_amounts AS pa
  ON pa.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holders AS ph
  ON ph.Agreement_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN agents AS ag
  ON ag.Agreement_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, cp.Policy_Number;

WITH ClaimPolicy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number,
        c.Claims_Made_Date,
        c.Claim_Close_Date
    FROM Claim AS c
    JOIN Claim_Coverage AS cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail AS pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy AS p
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
    WHERE c.Claims_Made_Date IS NOT NULL
      AND c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    Policy_Number,
    AVG(date_diff('day', Claims_Made_Date, Claim_Close_Date)) AS average_time_to_settle_days
FROM ClaimPolicy
GROUP BY Policy_Number;

WITH loss_amounts AS (

    JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
      ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount

    JOIN Expense_Payment ep

    JOIN Policy AS p

    AVG(la.Loss_Amount) AS Average_Loss

WITH claim_amount_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
premium_totals AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(pa.Policy_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier) AS Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr
      ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    GROUP BY COALESCE(pa.Policy_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier)
),
policy_parties AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier,
        LIST(DISTINCT apr.Party_Identifier) FILTER (
            WHERE UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(apr.Party_Role_Code, ' ', '_'), '-', '_'))
                  IN ('POLICYHOLDER', 'POLICY_HOLDER', 'INSURED', 'NAMED_INSURED')
        ) AS Policy_Holder_Party_Identifiers,
        LIST(DISTINCT apr.Party_Identifier) FILTER (
            WHERE UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(apr.Party_Role_Code, ' ', '_'), '-', '_'))
                  IN ('AGENT', 'PRODUCER')
        ) AS Agent_Party_Identifiers
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
    c.Company_Subclaim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    pp.Policy_Holder_Party_Identifiers,
    pp.Agent_Party_Identifiers,
    COALESCE(pt.Premium_Amount_Paid, 0) AS Premium_Amount_Paid,
    cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    COALESCE(catot.Loss_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(catot.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(catot.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(catot.Expense_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp
  ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_parties pp
  ON pp.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_totals pt
  ON pt.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat
  ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amount_totals catot
  ON catot.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier;

answer.sql:
SELECT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier) AS Policy_Count
FROM Policy AS p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role AS apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'Policy Holder'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier;

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Claim_Count
FROM Claim AS c
JOIN Claim_Coverage AS cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail AS pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy AS p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage AS cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail AS pcd
      ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
     AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
claim_losses AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)) AS Loss_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount AS ca
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM Loss_Payment AS lp
        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
       OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM Loss_Reserve AS lr
        WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        c.Company_Claim_Number,
        c.Claims_Made_Date,
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM Claim AS c
    JOIN Claim_Coverage AS cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail AS pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy AS p
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
claim_loss AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                 THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                 THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                 THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                 THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END
        ) AS Total_Loss
    FROM Claim_Amount AS ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment AS lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve AS lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment AS ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve AS er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
premium_by_policy AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
    FROM Premium AS pr
    JOIN Policy_Amount AS pa
        ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cp.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
    cp.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Identifier,
    COALESCE(cl.Total_Loss, 0) AS Total_Loss,
    COALESCE(pb.Premium_Amount_Paid, 0) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
FROM claim_policy AS cp
LEFT JOIN claim_loss AS cl
    ON cl.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_by_policy AS pb
    ON pb.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Agreement_Party_Role AS apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
   AND UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(apr.Party_Role_Code, '_', ''), ' ', '')) = 'POLICYHOLDER'
   AND (
       cp.Claims_Made_Date IS NULL
       OR (
           apr.Effective_Date <= cp.Claims_Made_Date
           AND (apr.Expiration_Date IS NULL OR apr.Expiration_Date >= cp.Claims_Made_Date)
       )
   );

    FROM Claim_Amount AS ca
    WHERE EXISTS (

        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (

    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Expense_Payment AS ep

    )
    OR EXISTS (

        WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claims_by_policy AS (
    SELECT
        cp.Policy_Identifier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
        SUM(COALESCE(lbc.total_loss, 0)) AS total_loss
    FROM claim_policy AS cp

      ON lbc.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY cp.Policy_Identifier
